description: This file defines the NavigationItem class and its subclass CategoryNavigationItem, which are used to represent navigation elements in the Android client of Nextcloud Notes. It includes properties like id, label, icon, count, and type, along with methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: NavigationItem
classes.description: Represents a navigation item with properties such as id, label, icon, count, and type. Includes methods for equality, hash code, and string conversion.

classes.name: NavigationItem.CategoryNavigationItem
classes.description: A subclass of NavigationItem representing a category-specific navigation item, with additional fields accountId and category, and overridden equals and hashCode methods.

methods.name: NavigationItem(String, String, Integer, int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a NavigationItem with id, label, count, and icon; sets type to UNCATEGORIZED if label is empty.

methods.name: NavigationItem(String, String, Integer, int, ENavigationCategoryType)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a NavigationItem with id, label, count, icon, and specific type.

methods.name: CategoryNavigationItem(String, String, Integer, int, long, String)
methods.description: Constructor for CategoryNavigationItem, initializing with id, label, count, icon, accountId, and category, setting type to DEFAULT_CATEGORY.

methods.name: equals(Object)
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare NavigationItem instances based on their properties.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on properties.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NavigationItem instance.
